reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter the grill password
reauth_confirm.description: {name} rejected the stored password. Enter the password set on the grill, or leave it empty if the grill has none.

set_grill_password.name: Set grill password
set_grill_password.description: Sets or removes the grill's password. The same password gates commands over Bluetooth and over the network, and Home Assistant's copy is updated at the same time so the two cannot drift apart.

password.name: Password
password.description: The new password. Leave empty to remove it, which leaves the grill accepting commands from anyone who can reach it. Note the app has its own reset procedure for a forgotten password; removing it here works by setting an empty one, which the firmware treats as no password.
